The plugin SDK

Everything a plugin author needs, in one download.

Plugin authors build against the loader ABI (plugin.h). The SDK ships a copy-this template, a full worked example, and offline tooling. It is distributed as Plugin-SDK.zip in the Extended /Public tree.

Authoring a plugin

  1. Copy template/ to your plugin id.
  2. Fill in manifest.txt and ranges.txt (all ranges above 0x7FFFFFFF).
  3. Edit src/plugin_entry.c — the ONE required export is sucs_plugin_entry().
  4. Add codepoint tables in plugin_data.c, plus optional mappings and collation.
  5. Pack and verify offline.
plugin_pack org.openwindows.hellocp 1 0 0 ranges.txt payload.bin hellocp.sucsplugin
plugin_verify hellocp.sucsplugin # checksum gate: PASS/FAIL

hellocp — the worked example

hellocp declares 4096 codepoints at 0x80000000–0x80000FFF, ships a two-entry data table, packs and verifies clean. Its blob passes the exact gate the boot loader runs.

Download: Plugin-SDK.zip from the /Public tree. Sources: modules/unicode-extended → plugin/sdk/.
